_comment: Expansion 3 part F.6 (and F.8: Animal Shapes, Shapechange): Polymorph and True Polymorph (the effects op 'shape': Battle.shape, rules/shapes.py). The forms are the creatures the game has; the game picks the strongest for a friend, the weakest for a foe.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.text: A creature within 60 feet becomes a beast no stronger than itself while you concentrate: a friend the strongest it may be, a foe (on a failed Wisdom save) the weakest. Its hit points stay; the beast's come as temporary ones, and the shape ends when they are gone. No spells in it.

true_polymorph.name: True Polymorph
true_polymorph.text: A creature within 30 feet becomes any creature no stronger than itself while you concentrate: a friend the strongest it may be, a foe (on a failed Wisdom save) the weakest. Its hit points stay; the form's come as temporary ones, and the shape ends when they are gone. No spells in it.

animal_shapes.name: Animal Shapes
animal_shapes.text: For a day, each friend within 30 feet who casts no spells becomes the strongest Large or smaller beast of CR 4 or less, the beast's hit points as temporary ones. A Bonus Action leaves it; your Magic action changes them again. On the road: the whole party, as the beast you choose.

shapechange.name: Shapechange
shapechange.text: For up to an hour you become a creature of CR no higher than your level (never a construct or undead), keeping your mind and your spells; its hit points come as temporary ones. A Magic action shifts you into another shape with fresh ones.
